subject: design-technology
title: CAD: SolidWorks and Fusion 360
welcome_lead: Parametric solid modelling — the designer's standard tool.
meta_desc: A-Level D&T: parametric CAD with SolidWorks and Fusion 360.
final_note: The 3D model is the master record.

concepts.def: CAD where dimensions and relations are editable parameters.
Geometric relation (e.g. parallel, tangent) fixing sketch behaviour.
Ordered history of modelling operations that produce a part.

walkthroughs.body_html: SolidWorks (since 1995) and Fusion 360 (since 2013) are leading parametric CAD packages. SolidWorks is desktop, file-based; Fusion 360 is cloud-based and integrates CAM, simulation and rendering.
Sketch with constraints (coincident, parallel, equal), add dimensions, extrude/revolve into features. The feature tree stores history — change a dimension and everything updates.
A modern CAD model carries: tolerances (GD&T), material, mass, cost, manufacturing data and simulation results. It becomes the digital twin of the eventual physical part.
